decisions.title: One Authority API as modular system of record
decisions.context: Three client applications and one worker share one business context and one data model.

options.summary: Single modular API owning the data, consumed by every client.
One service per client application with a shared database.

decisions.rationale: One authority keeps authorization and state transitions in one place; nothing measured justifies distribution.
consequences: Every client goes through the API; no client reads the database.

decisions.title: Dedicated Async Worker fed by domain events
decisions.context: Notifications, escalations and attachment analysis are slow or scheduled and must not block the API.

options.summary: Separate worker process consuming domain events published through a transactional outbox.
Background jobs inside the API process.
tradeoffs: Scaling the API scales the jobs

decisions.rationale: Isolates slow and scheduled work from the request path and lets it scale independently.
consequences: The worker is a first-class component with its own deployment unit.
The API publishes events through an outbox, never directly to the worker.

decisions.title: Two distinct Web applications
decisions.context: The public portal and the internal back-office have different audiences, exposure and accessibility obligations.

options.summary: A public Requester Web and an internal Ops Web.
One Web application with role-based areas.
risks: Internal screens reachable from the public surface

decisions.rationale: Separate exposure surfaces reduce the attack surface of the back-office and let each app follow its own design context.

decisions.title: Offline-first Field Mobile with idempotent synchronization
decisions.context: Field agents lose connectivity during their shift (AMB-001: up to 12 hours).

options.summary: Local store on the device and idempotent replay to the API at reconnection.

decisions.rationale: Only option that satisfies FR-004 within the resolved offline window.

decisions.title: Shared Enistere OIDC provider, realm asteria
decisions.context: The Enistere production policy provides a shared Keycloak with one realm per project.

options.summary: Dedicated realm on the shared Enistere identity provider.

risks: Exception to the production policy requires an ADR

decisions.rationale: Complies with the production policy without exception.

operations.summary: Upload a photo or document; it stays PENDING until analysed.

authorization.intent: An authenticated requester or field agent uploads on their own behalf.
An authenticated requester creates a request on their own behalf.

operations.summary: List the requests of the calling requester.

authorization.intent: A requester only reads their own requests.

operations.summary: Assign a triaged request to a field agent.
List the assignments of the calling field agent.

authorization.intent: A field agent only reads their own assignments.

operations.summary: Record the report of an intervention (replayable after offline work).

authorization.intent: The assigned field agent reports on their own assignment.

operations.summary: Record the malware analysis result of an attachment.

authorization.intent: Only the platform worker identity records analysis results.

operations.summary: Escalate an overdue request to a supervisor.

authorization.intent: Only the platform worker identity escalates, on schedule.

invariants.statement: A request is located inside the served territory.
Status transitions follow SUBMITTED → TRIAGED → ASSIGNED → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED → CLOSED; REJECTED only from SUBMITTED or TRIAGED.
An assignment targets exactly one active field agent and one request that is TRIAGED or ASSIGNED.
An attachment is never exposed before its scan status is CLEAN.

events.description: Published through the transactional outbox on every status transition.

acceptance.scenario: A requester uploads a photo, submits a geolocated request and sees it SUBMITTED.
An operations agent triages and assigns a request; the field agent sees the assignment.
A report recorded offline is replayed twice after reconnection and stored once.
An infected attachment is never exposed to any role.
An overdue request is escalated once to a supervisor.
Each status transition produces exactly one requester notification.

rules.rationale: Production policy: shared Keycloak, one realm per project.
Production policy: images are deployed by immutable digest, never latest.
Client asked to reuse its own directory.

waivers.reason: Object storage replica in eu-central during the hosting migration window.

trace.reason: Object storage replica in eu-central during the hosting migration window.

acceptance.rationale: Extracted candidates reviewed one by one; ambiguity AMB-001 resolved in workshop, AMB-002 deferred.

goals.statement: Requesters submit and follow service requests without phone calls.
Operations triage and dispatch every request within its service level.
Field agents execute interventions even without connectivity.

actors.name: Requester
actors.description: Member of the public who reports an issue.

requirements.statement: A requester submits a geolocated service request with a category, a description and photos.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A submitted request is stored with status SUBMITTED, its location and its attachments.

requirements.statement: A requester follows the status of their own requests.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The requester lists their requests with their current status and nothing else.

requirements.statement: An operations agent triages, prioritizes and assigns requests to field agents.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A triaged request carries a priority; an assigned request names one field agent and a due date.

requirements.statement: A field agent receives assignments and records an intervention report with photos, including while offline.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A report recorded offline is synchronized once, without duplicate, after reconnection.

requirements.statement: A requester is notified by e-mail of every status change of their requests.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Each status change produces exactly one notification to the requester.

requirements.statement: A request that exceeds its service level is escalated automatically to a supervisor.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An overdue request is escalated once and the supervisor is identified.

requirements.statement: A public anonymized map shows open requests.
Long-running processing (notifications, escalations, attachment analysis) is asynchronous and never blocks a request to the API.
Requesters only see their own requests; field agents only see their own assignments.
An uploaded attachment is analysed for malware before it becomes visible to anyone.
The public requester portal meets WCAG 2.2 level AA.
Authentication uses the shared Enistere OIDC provider with a dedicated realm for the project.

ambiguities.question: How long must a field agent be able to work offline?
ambiguities.resolution: One shift (at most 12 hours); synchronization at reconnection.

ambiguities.question: Which notification channels are needed besides e-mail?

spec.purpose: Collect, dispatch and resolve field service requests, from the public portal to the intervention report.

Escalates overdue requests on schedule.

constraints: Horizontal scaling independent from the API.

responsibilities: Transactional storage of requests, assignments, reports and the outbox.

responsibilities: Stores attachments; never exposed before analysis.
